props.text: Ten years of taking the slower option and writing about what happened. No sponsored posts, no affiliate links, no photographs that are not mine.
The only travel writing I read that makes the journey sound better than the destination.
The three questions that arrive by email every single week.

items: Can I follow the routes with children?
Most of them, yes. Where a route breaks with a pram or a bored nine-year-old, the letter says so plainly.
Sometimes, and it is marked. Crossing an ocean by ship is a week I do not always have.
Take them. A credit is welcome if you are publishing, but they are written to be used.
